applicability.reason: Aura has material complete user journeys across a shared React UI and an Android Capacitor/native boundary that lower-level tests alone cannot fully prove.

critical_journeys.claim: A user can inspect the month, record/review spending, and obtain the resulting budget/safe-to-spend state coherently.
residual_gaps: packaged Android WebView and device-specific lifecycle/accessibility behavior

critical_journeys.claim: A user can export/import the supported portable financial-data surface without silently changing canonical ledger semantics.
residual_gaps: Android file-picker/storage-provider integration for the packaged application

critical_journeys.claim: An Android payment candidate remains outside the canonical ledger until the user reviews and explicitly confirms or ignores it.
residual_gaps: OEM process lifecycle and reboot recovery
critical_journeys.automation_gap_reason: The repository has instrumentation and emulator-oriented verification scripts, but current CI does not yet provision the isolated Android Firebase/OAuth/Google Services configuration needed to run the packaged debug surface safely.

critical_journeys.claim: The built Android debug artifact installs, launches, renders the shared application and recovers across the supported native lifecycle.
critical_journeys.automation_gap_reason: Android scripts exist, but a repository-owned CI fixture for the isolated debug Firebase/OAuth/Google Services configuration is still required before emulator automation can be authoritative.
